comment: Deal pricing discipline (Client Profitability, mv_deal_pricing): one row per credit deal signed since 1-Apr-2023 with the priced margin vs the margin needed for the RoRWA hurdle, the standalone RoRWA, the origination RAROC (incl. the client's ancillary revenue) vs the 12% RAROC hurdle, the approval exception (reason, approver), and the realised RAROC once the deal has seasoned (deals signed up to Mar-2026; later deals are Not yet seasoned) with a caught-up flag (realised RAROC back at or above the hurdle). RAROC values are winsorised to -0.25..1.00; flags come from the unwinsorised ratios. Average RAROC across deals with AVG or amount-weighted SUM(raroc x amount) / SUM(amount). Grain: one row per deal (credit facility) signed from FY2023.
